title: Ask HN: As a teacher how should I teach kids to use AI?
content_html:
Hi,

An institution asked me to help them in teaching poor kids to use AI and about AI. They are between 7 - 14 years old from poor families in third world country.

I think DeepSeek is a good choice as it has very good free credits with strong models.

And I will ask each one of them what they like and help them to use AI to accelerate their learning on that topic.

I will also talk about threats of excessive AI usage if you only get to answers and skip the learning process entirely.

But I wanted to ask you for some help how would do it and what other suggestions do you have?
